scope: Explicit enrolment and attachment slash commands from the OpenCode landing screen, where no native session exists yet.
cause: Both commands previously returned silently when the selected route had no session ID.
unitCoverage: The selected landing-screen model and variant are carried into session creation without permission overrides.
A lost session-create reply reuses the original persisted native ID rather than creating another chat.
An existing confirmed attachment is reconciled before creating any new session.
Attachment without an enrolment reports the prerequisite without creating an unused chat.
Switch, reconnect, reload and disposal during creation prevent navigation hijacking and grant publication.
Dismissing manual confirmation cannot be bypassed by the new session's delayed automatic-attachment event.
limitations: Actual native services and TUIs, with synthetic keyboard/navigation input and a deterministic model.
Not actual-human acceptance of the landing-screen commands.
The focused landing probe skips minute cron ticks and does not claim recurring-cron acceptance.
